metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Node.js (stdlib-only) BibTeX-like CLI in `output/` with entry point `output/main.js`.

- Runs as `node output/main.js --bib <file> --style <file> (--cites <file> | --aux <file>) --output <file> [--log <file>]`
- Parses `.bib` (entries, `@string`, `@preamble`, `crossref` inheritance) and `.bst` (standard style language: functions, stack VM, `READ`/`SORT`/`ITERATE`/`REVERSE`/`EXECUTE`)
- Writes `.bbl` to `--output` on success (UTF-8, LF, 79-col wrapping); writes error JSON to `--output` on failure (exit 1)
- Writes structured JSON log to `--log` when requested

Files added:
- `output/main.js`
- `output/pipeline.js`
- `output/bibParser.js`
- `output/bstParser.js`
- `output/bstVm.js`
- `output/cites.js`
- `output/errors.js`
- `output/util.js`
- `output/warnings.js`
